name: ninjaone-pp-mcp
description: Every NinjaOne endpoint plus fleet-wide cross-org commands the org-scoped console can't give you.

ninjaone_client_id.title: NINJAONE_CLIENT_ID
ninjaone_client_id.description: Sets NINJAONE_CLIENT_ID for the NinjaOne MCP server. Get a credential from https://app.ninjarmm.com/#/administration/apps/api.

ninjaone_client_secret.title: NINJAONE_CLIENT_SECRET
ninjaone_client_secret.description: Sets NINJAONE_CLIENT_SECRET for the NinjaOne MCP server. Get a credential from https://app.ninjarmm.com/#/administration/apps/api.

ninjaone_oauth_scope.title: NINJAONE_OAUTH_SCOPE
ninjaone_oauth_scope.description: Sets NINJAONE_OAUTH_SCOPE for the NinjaOne MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
